overview.en: This elusive rattlesnake is known from western Mexico, especially the Sierra de Manantlán region of Jalisco.
overview.fr: Ce crotale discret est connu de l’ouest du Mexique, notamment de la Sierra de Manantlán, dans le Jalisco.

identification.en: It has a slender, unusually long tail and a gray ground colour marked with dark dorsal blotches.
identification.fr: Il possède une queue fine et exceptionnellement longue, sur un fond gris marqué de taches dorsales sombres.

habitat.en: Available records place it in rocky grassland near the transition between tropical deciduous and pine-oak forests.
habitat.fr: Les données disponibles le situent dans des prairies rocheuses, entre forêt tropicale déciduale et forêt de pins et chênes.

diet.en: The Mexican species account lists lizards, arthropods and other reptiles among its reported prey.
diet.fr: La fiche mexicaine de l’espèce cite les lézards, les arthropodes et d’autres reptiles parmi ses proies rapportées.

behavior.en: It may be active at dusk or night and has been observed thermoregulating beside grasses or on low shrubs.
behavior.fr: Il serait actif au crépuscule ou la nuit et régulerait sa température près des herbes ou sur de petits arbustes.

reproduction.en: Reliable species-specific breeding information is scarce in the sources consulted.
reproduction.fr: Les sources consultées fournissent peu d’informations fiables sur sa reproduction.

ecology.en: It belongs to the rare long-tailed rattlesnake group, alongside Crotalus stejnegeri and Crotalus ericsmithi.
ecology.fr: Il appartient au groupe rare des crotales à longue queue, avec Crotalus stejnegeri et Crotalus ericsmithi.

conservation.en: Mexico lists it as threatened; rediscovery reports and few locality records underline the need for further surveys.
conservation.fr: Le Mexique la classe comme espèce menacée; les redécouvertes et rares localités connues justifient de nouveaux inventaires.

uncertainties: The limited and uneven locality record does not support a precise population estimate or a confident trend assessment.
review_note: Compared CONABIO’s species summary with the rediscovery paper and the Reptile Database; treated status as Mexican rather than global.

facts: CONABIO summary gives the known specimen description, Jalisco locality, rocky ecotone, reported prey, tentative activity and Mexican threatened category.

title.en: Rediscovery of the rare Autlán long-tailed rattlesnake
title.fr: Redécouverte du rare crotale à longue queue d’Autlán

facts: Peer-reviewed rediscovery account places this rare taxon in the long-tailed rattlesnake group and documents renewed field records after its original description.

facts: Taxonomic database lists Crotalus lannomi as valid and gives its range as southwestern Mexico, including Jalisco and Colima.
